ai.answerCustomersText: The assistant answers new widget conversations from its knowledge. It hands a conversation to the team with a private note when it cannot help, and can offer one feedback request that the customer submits.
ai.assistantText: The name and the voice of the assistant that answers customers.
ai.description: Set up the AI assistant that answers customers, its knowledge and the copilot for your team.
ai.instructionsPlaceholder: Always give the link to the status page when a service is down.
ai.knowledgeText: The sources that the assistant uses to answer customers.
ai.name: Name
ai.productPlaceholder: A project manager for small teams, with a free plan and a paid plan.
ai.notConfigured: AI is not set up on this instance. An instance administrator must add an AI provider before the assistant can answer.

email.addText: The workspace sends email for the area that you choose from this address.
email.description: Receive and answer customer email in your conversations.
email.domainInUse: The domain could not be removed. Remove its sending addresses first.
email.failed: The change could not be saved.
email.forwardText: Each support email that arrives also goes to this address.

email.trustText: Choose if inbound email must pass the sender checks of its domain.

general.abandonedText: Close a chat when the visitor leaves before a teammate answers.
general.autoAckText: Save the choice to confirm each new email. This instance does not send the reply yet.
general.awayReplyText: Answer a customer automatically when no teammate is online or it is outside office hours. It repeats at most every 12 hours in a conversation.
general.closeSpamText: Close a conversation when the spam filter marks it as spam.
general.description: Set the service levels, the office hours and how new conversations reach your team.
general.hoursNote: This page does not change your holidays.
general.hoursOnText: When off, the team is always open.
general.portalText: Show the support tab on the portal.
general.routingText: Give each new conversation to a teammate who is online.
general.sameTime: Use a closing time that differs from the opening time.
general.slaText: New conversations get this policy when no workflow sets one.
general.timeInvalid: Enter a time as HH:MM, such as 09:00.
general.title: General
general.waitText: The time that the chat stays open after the visitor leaves.

moderation.classifierText: Let AI check inbound conversations for spam.
moderation.clearText: Posts and comments that wait for approval show here.
